status: DRAFT: design approved by Madhav 19 Oct 2026 18:28 Toronto ('i approve, but please make sure we are doing the right thing'); independent review before freeze
title: Scenario Playbook phase 1: index intraday playbook (Nifty 50, Nifty Bank), executed through weekly options in the Rs 60,000 book, futures tracked as a shadow book
why: OC v1 (19 Oct): no fixed opening rule pays its costs; the day (breadth, agreement) mattered more than the instrument; shorts and longs differed. So learn which action fits which situation, and test the learned policy as one object out of sample.

data.index: silver/kite_index/minute 2015-2023: NIFTY 50, NIFTY BANK, INDIA VIX (regular full sessions; special sessions excluded)
data.breadth: gold/studies/OC1_breadth.parquet (eligible liquidity top 50, OC v1 rules)
data.overnight: silver/macro (FRED SP500, NASDAQCOM, DEXINUS, DCOILBRENTEU, VIXCLS), silver/flows/participant_oi (FII long share), silver/kite_index/day (trend)
data.options: silver/fo_greeks (previous session's IV per contract and the forward), silver/fo_calendar (expiries), lot sizes from silver/fo_bhavcopy
data.never: sealed/ (2024 onward) is not read; it is opened once, for the final policy, by a separate registration

decision_points.D0: 09:15 open (overnight information only; entry at the 09:15 bar's open)
decision_points.D1: close of the 09:29 bar (09:30; OR15 known); entry at the 09:30 bar's open
decision_points.rule: the policy is sequential: at D0, D1, D2, D3 in order, if no position in that index yet, it takes the action with the highest predicted value if that value is above 0 net bps; otherwise it waits; nothing by D3 = NO TRADE. One trade per index per day.

overnight.trend: Nifty previous close vs its 50- and 200-day averages: up (above both), down (below both), mixed
overnight.vix: India VIX previous close, terciles of the training years
overnight.us: S&P 500 return of the last US session completed before 09:15 IST (FRED SP500, latest date strictly before the Indian date): down <= -0.5%, flat, up >= +0.5%
overnight.fx_oil: USD/INR (DEXINUS) and Brent changes over the last available day: rupee weaker by 0.3% or more, or Brent up 2% or more = 'pressure'; the reverse = 'relief'; else 'calm'
overnight.positioning: FII long share of index futures (participant OI) at the previous close, terciles of the training years
overnight.event: scheduled verified event today (RBI decision, Union Budget, election counting) / verified event whose first tradable session was in the previous 3 sessions / none
overnight.expiry: weekly expiry day of that index: yes / no

opening.gap: open vs previous close: down <= -0.25%, flat, up >= +0.25%
opening.move: index move since the 09:15 open at the decision bar, terciles of the training years for that decision point
opening.breadth: share of eligible top 50 above their own open (last closed 5-minute bar): <= 0.40, mid, >= 0.60
opening.agreement: Nifty 50 and Nifty Bank both moved at least 0.05% the same way since 09:15: yes / no
opening.or_width: opening-range width (OR15 at D1, OR30 at D2/D3) over the previous session's daily ATR14, terciles of the training years

state.rule: every feature uses only bars closed by the decision time and data dated before the session; tercile cut-offs are fitted on each fold's training years only; D0 uses the overnight features and the gap

exits.T1130: time exit at the 11:30 bar's open, no stop
exits.T1515: time exit at the 15:15 bar's open, no stop
exits.ORSTOP: stop at the opposite OR15 edge (D0: 0.5 x previous daily ATR14), else 15:15
exits.ATRSTOP: stop at 0.5 x previous daily ATR14 from entry, else 15:15
exits.TRAIL: chandelier trail: 3 x ATR14 of 5-minute bars from the best price since entry, else 15:15
exits.NEXTOPEN: hold to the next session's open; intraday stop 1 x previous daily ATR14 (overnight gap not protected)

actions.count: 2 directions x 6 exits = 12 actions per decision point, 48 per index, plus NO TRADE

outcomes.future_proxy: net bps of the index per trade: spot minutes as the near-month future, Zerodha futures fees of that year on one lot, 1 tick slippage each side (the OC v1 convention)
outcomes.option: Rs per lot: buy the ATM weekly call (long) or put (short) at entry; nearest expiry after the trade date (on an expiry day, the next one); strike nearest the index at entry; Black-76 with the previous session's IV of that contract (nearest listed strike of the expiry if missing) and the previous session's forward/spot carry; IV held through the trade (labelled SYNTHETIC); exits follow the index; option fees of that year, half-spread Rs 0.50 (NIFTY) / Rs 1.00 (BANKNIFTY) per unit each side, stress x2
outcomes.unit_note: the policy is learned and tested on the future-proxy outcome; the option outcome is how the Rs 60,000 book would have executed it

learning.model: for each index x decision point x action: ridge regression of the future-proxy net bps on one-hot state features (main effects; one level dropped per feature), intercept unpenalised, target winsorised at the training 1st/99th percentiles for fitting only; lambda by leave-one-year-out CV within the training years from {1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000} (a single training year: lambda 100)
learning.walk_forward: expanding: test year y in 2016..2023 uses a model fitted on 2015..y-1 only
learning.option_value: a second ridge of the same form on the option Rs outcome, used only for sizing

sizing_and_survival.lots: n = floor(0.25 x W x mu / sigma^2) per trade, mu = predicted option Rs per lot, sigma^2 = training residual variance of that action's option outcome; n >= 1 only if the policy trades and mu > 0; total premium of open positions <= 40% of W; W = book equity at the start of the session
sizing_and_survival.survival: paper_config.json survival: realised plus open loss of 5% of the session's starting equity closes everything for the day; equity 22% below its high-water mark pauses new entries until Madhav resumes (the backtest reports when it would have paused and also the unpaused path)
sizing_and_survival.book: Rs 60,000 on 2016-01-01 (the first test year), both indices

rows: NIFTY|future_proxy|policy: daily net bps (0 on no-trade days) > 0
NIFTY|future_proxy|vs_best_fixed: policy minus the single best (decision point, action) chosen on the same training years, per day, > 0
NIFTY|option|policy: daily net Rs per lot (0 on no-trade days) > 0
BOOK|option|sized: daily Rs of the Rs 60,000 book with sizing and survival rules > 0
tests.periods: dev = walk-forward test years 2016-2017; validation = test years 2018-2023 (every prediction is out of sample)
robustness_extras: costs x2 and option spread x2
per-year results (8 folds; robust if >= 5 positive)
random action within the same state and the same days traded (500 draws, p)
share of days traded and which (point, action) the policy chose
the learned coefficients: what Ananta learned about each situation
equity, max drawdown, daily-limit hits, pause dates of the sized book

shadow_books.index_futures: the same decisions as 1 lot of the near-month future (research: the future-proxy outcome; forward: recorded future minutes)
shadow_books.forex: USDINR, EURINR, GBPINR, JPYINR near-month futures recorded at 1 minute from 21 Oct 2026; phase SP-FX designs and tests forex decisions before any are made

later_phases.SP2: top-100 stocks intraday, the same structure per stock-day (5-minute bars)
later_phases.SP3: positional: stocks and index, entry at the open after a signal, holds of 1-20 sessions with the exit harness policies, daily data from 2005

limits: spot as the future (basis ignored); synthetic options with IV held constant (no event IV crush) until the recorder calibrates them (R01)
breadth from the covered top 50 (75-93% by year)
dev test years are only 2016-2017 (index minutes start 2015)
